scope: docs index exposure gates for existing-hub, low-density route surfaces, and GitHub Pages live verification

gates.title: Existing hub entry router
guardrails: choose an existing hub or section checkpoint before creating any new hub
do not promote this gate into graph/data, catalogs, README, or landing surfaces in this lane

gates.title: Low-density hub/path exposure checkpoint
guardrails: expose one grouped section link and one coverage link instead of five per-axis links
only use existing root markdown route, walkthrough, checklist, FAQ, and source notes
stop before graph/data, generated catalogs, README, landing, commit, or push work

gates.title: GitHub Pages live docs verification checkpoint
guardrails: verify the published GitHub Pages docs/index.html only after merge/deploy; do not assume local links prove live exposure
live check is read-only: confirm docs/index.html exposes gates.json, existing-hub router, low-density section, and coverage links
if Pages is stale or 404, record deploy/cache status instead of editing graph/data, catalogs, README, or landing files
compare live HTML labels against local docs/index.html and docs/gates.json targets; HTTP 200 alone is not sufficient evidence
live comparison guardrail: status 200 with stale/mismatched title must be recorded as WAIT/live-local mismatch, not PASS or completed exposure

lastLiveCheck.guardrail: Second WAIT evidence: HTTP 200 alone is not sufficient; expected route title is absent while the gateway title is present, so keep Pages reflection classified as WAIT-2, not PASS.
